* The first sample ([SAMPLE-001](./NUBes/SAMPLE-001)) has been annotated following a process involving 2 annotators and

metadata.value: Sensitive information substituted with fake similar data; sentences shuffled and scattered across samples to hinder de-anonymization
metadata.normalized_value: Sensitive information substituted with fake similar data; sentences shuffled and scattered across samples to hinder de-anonymization
metadata.evidence:
All sensitive information (e.g., people names, healthcare facilities, dates, and so on) in NUBes have been subsituted
with fake similar data. Furthermore, the sentences have been shuffled in order to hinder de-anonymization efforts as
much as possible.
metadata.reason: Documents anonymization measures, important for ethical/legal reuse of clinical data.

metadata.value: "bin"/"binary" (binary classification), "class"/"type" (category classification), "full" (category and BIO-tag classification); paper results correspond to category classification
metadata.normalized_value: "bin"/"binary" (binary classification), "class"/"type" (category classification), "full" (category and BIO-tag classification); paper results correspond to category classification
metadata.evidence:
It offers 3 evaluation scenarios:
   1. "bin" or "binary": binary classification (i.e., "IN" or "OUT")
   2. "class" or "type": category classification
   3. "full": category and BIO-tag classification
   
The results reported in the paper correspond to the category classification scenario.
metadata.reason: Defines the evaluation modes and which one reproduces the paper's reported results.
